quote: Corporate unsecured loan to support the Borrower’s development and construction of four solar power plants in Mexico totaling 426 megawatts of aggregate nameplate capacity. Up to USD $241 million. Total Project Costs $441 million.
note: Opened DFC Public Information Summary 9000093572 (USD 241m / 426 MW / USD 441m project costs); Board BDR(20)12 dated 11 Mar 2020.
